surviving_alternatives: NetworkX algorithm coverage, PyG batching, heterogeneous graphs, graph neural networks, and lego graph-cell promotion remain separate future receipts.
The older NetworkX capability JSON is treated as contextual history, not as a strict prior receipt for this clean integration micro.
demotion_condition: Demote this NetworkX-PyG handoff if node mappings are not exact, edge orientation is not preserved, isolated nodes disappear, or PyG messages diverge from NetworkX incoming-neighbor sums.
out_of_scope: no proof of the whole NetworkX or PyG libraries
no tool-tool coupling beyond this exact graph handoff
criteria_checked: exact node-order mapping into PyG Data
